'''"Run Kessel Run" ''' was a popular [[Music/Legends|tune]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Listen2|RunKesselRun.flac|"Run Kessel Run"|A short sample clip}}
"Run Kessel Run" is background music heard in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can select it in [[Jukebox/Legends|jukeboxes]] using a jukebox token.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
